catches: Offer is only available in person at OnPoint Community Credit Union's Camas Branch (19542 SE Brady Rd, Suite 101, Camas, WA 98607); openings at any other branch or online do not qualify.
Account must be opened between September 3, 2026 and December 3, 2026.
A direct deposit of at least $500 must post within 60 days of account opening.
The $200 credit is made approximately 60 days after the account is opened and the direct deposit is established — not immediately.
Accounts must be open and in good standing at the time of payout; must be 18 or older.
The bonus is reported on a 1099-INT for tax purposes (taxed as interest).
Offer is subject to change or withdrawal without notice.
